current_cases.name: agreement_int64_factorial_overflow_21_raters
current_cases.explanation: A single reference draw matches 14 of 21 raters. Pandas NumPy-integer counts enter the factorial cache and overflow at 21!.

current_cases.name: cross_entropy_after_agreement_cache_contamination
current_cases.explanation: The same valid cross-entropy call changes with previous Agreement calls because the shared factorial cache contains overflowed integers.

current_cases.name: cross_entropy_fresh_cache_control
current_cases.explanation: A control: Python-integer factorials avoid the NumPy-integer overflow in this small example.

current_cases.explanation: The four equiprobable complete reference vectors give scores [0.0, 0.25, 0.25, 0.0]; their arithmetic mean is 0.125. Current code instead returns abs(det(E[joint])).

current_cases.name: DMIScore_for_Soft_Classifier_expected_score_contract
current_cases.explanation: The four equiprobable complete reference vectors give scores [0.0, 0.15, 0.15, 0.0]; their arithmetic mean is 0.075. Current code instead returns abs(det(E[joint])).

current_cases.name: precision_anonymous_uses_different_averaging
current_cases.explanation: With one deterministic reference column, anonymous expected_score should equal score. Direct/default micro precision is 1/2; anonymous precision conditions only on the positive prediction and returns 1.

current_cases.name: multiclass_panel_replacement_policy
current_cases.explanation: Uniform three-rater subsets give P(a)=2/3. Exhausting the implemented with-replacement draws and ties gives 9/16. Actual sampler replacement flags: [True]. Binary closed forms instead use without-replacement subsets.

current_cases.name: correlation_anonymous_mean_unimplemented
current_cases.explanation: The sole possible numeric reference vector equals the predictions, so Pearson correlation is 1. The default numeric mean combiner is not implemented by the anonymous sampling path.
